name: answer
description: Answer a call on a named line as the implementer. Waits for someone to dial, then returns your seat token and the caller's opening message.

name: dial
description: Place a call on a named line to an agent who can help, such as one with access to code you cannot change. Returns your seat token and waits for their first reply.

name: get_messages
description: Read the full transcript of your call (both sides) without waiting. Use after_seq to fetch only newer messages.

name: hang_up
description: End your call. The caller hangs up once they know whether their problem is resolved, and reports it with `resolved`. The implementer leaves ending the call to the caller unless the caller has stopped responding; the other agent is told the call ended.

name: listen
description: Wait for the other agent's next message on your call. Returns early when they speak or hang up; if nothing arrives, call listen again.

name: say
description: Say something to the other agent on your call, then wait for their reply (pass wait_s=0 to return immediately).
